text: Heather rang this morning. She's finally found a flat in Leeds and moves in sometime next month. I should send her a plant for the new place once she's settled.

Ravi and his wife Ana are viewing a two-bed in Walthamstow on Saturday at 11. They're hoping to put an offer in the same day if it's any good. Ana is keen on it because it's near her work, but Ravi thinks the second bedroom is basically a cupboard. They've already lost two places this month to cash buyers, so they're both a bit fed up.
Joe's driving test is on Thursday at 2pm and he's really nervous about the roundabouts. Remind me to text him good luck that morning.
Coffee with Yaw. He's thinking of moving back to Accra in the spring, though nothing is decided yet.
Francesca's housewarming has been called off because the boiler packed in. She says she'll do something after Christmas instead, once the flat is warm again.
Julia mentioned her mum is having a hip operation on the 12th at half 9. Need to ring Julia the next day to see how it went.
Suzanne is vegetarian and doesn't drink coffee, only green tea.
Olivia said she'd love a decent cast iron pan. Hers cracked in the move.
Pick up the spare keys from the letting agent tomorrow morning before 10.
Beatriz Reyes starts her new job at the museum on Monday. She's been worrying about the commute from Croydon. Must message her on Monday evening to ask how the first day went.

Long call with Fatima tonight. Her brother Ivan is moving to Berlin at the end of the month for a research post, and the family are throwing him a leaving dinner on the Friday before he goes. She's struggling a bit because he's the one who usually helps with their dad. I should check in with her a week after he leaves, and maybe send Ivan a card.
Darius and Reza got engaged last weekend! The party will be sometime in the summer, probably in Bristol.
Kenji's cat Miso went missing on Tuesday. He found her the next day hiding in the neighbour's shed, very pleased with herself.
Remind me to ask Siddharth how the flat viewing in Manchester went. It was yesterday afternoon.
Matilda's daughter graduates from Edinburgh on 3 July at 10am. Matilda is driving up the night before and staying until the Sunday afterwards.
Tomás said he might come and visit soon, possibly around half term. Nothing firm yet.
Alessia is allergic to nuts and sesame, and she can't stand coriander.
Kiara is moving in with her boyfriend in March. She's excited but a bit anxious about leaving the house share.

Petra's dog Bruno has his operation on Friday morning. She's dropping him at the vet at 8 and collecting him that evening. Don't forget to text her afterwards. She's been really anxious about it because he's nearly twelve and the vet was honest about the risks with the anaesthetic. Her mum is going with her to collect him.
Hannah and Emeka are having a baby! Due sometime in early spring. Their little boy is going to be a big brother and apparently has opinions about names already.

Rana called. Her dad passed away on Sunday and the funeral is next Thursday at 1pm. I need to send flowers the day before and ask whether she wants company afterwards. Her brother is flying back from Toronto on Tuesday to help sort things out, and she's staying at her mum's for the rest of the week.
Sunil got the flat in Glasgow! He gets the keys on the 28th.
I'm going to Barbara's for lunch on Sunday at 1 and bringing dessert.
Antoine Dubois mentioned he's into bouldering and goes to the wall in Bermondsey most Tuesdays.
Svetlana has a job interview at the council on Wednesday at 3pm. Must message her the night before to wish her luck.

Zeynep's sister is getting married in Izmir in May. Zeynep and Mehmet are flying out a week before to help set up. Mehmet is giving a speech at the reception and is already panicking about it. They're staying on for a few days afterwards and might visit his cousins in Ankara.
Mehmet said the move to the new house went fine, apart from the van turning up two hours late. Their kids love having a garden.
Book the removal van for sometime early next month. Compare prices on Thursday.
Heather says the new flat is lovely but the neighbours are loud. She's been sleeping badly since the move.
Ravi's birthday is on the 14th. He's mentioned a few times that he wants a good pair of running headphones.
Ana's nan turns ninety in the new year. The whole family is getting together for a lunch that weekend.
Joe called to say the trip to Lisbon is off. His boss cancelled his leave at the last minute and he's gutted.

Yaw's mum is in hospital for tests. He's going up to see her on Saturday morning. I should ring him on Sunday to see how she is. He's trying not to worry, but the doctors haven't told them much and his sister is meant to be travelling that weekend, so it's mostly falling on him.

Lunch with Francesca and Julia today. Francesca is finally leaving the agency at Christmas and going freelance in the new year. Julia has been offered a place on the teaching course in Sheffield starting in September, so she'll be moving up sometime over the summer. We talked about a weekend away before she goes, maybe in June. Need to sort dates with both of them soon.
Suzanne's son starts nursery on Monday. She's dreading the drop-off far more than he is.
Olivia wants to meet up sometime after her exams. Remind me to message her in a couple of weeks.
Beatriz and her husband are viewing houses in Bath on Saturday. Three viewings, the first at 10am and the last one at 4, with lunch somewhere in between.
Need to measure the alcove in the new flat before ordering the bookshelf. Ideally this weekend.
Fatima (Fati to everyone at work) is doing the Great North Run in September. She's been training every morning before work.
Ivan has moved to Berlin. He sent a photo of his new flat yesterday and it looks tiny. Don't forget to post him the jumper he left here.
Darius said Reza's grandmother died last week. The funeral was on Monday. He seemed quite low about it all.
Kenji is going to be in London for a conference sometime in November. We should get dinner while he's here.
Siddharth (Sid) is a structural engineer and is obsessed with old Saabs. He has two in his garage and neither of them runs.

Matilda rang about the house move. Completion has slipped again and is now pencilled in for the 19th, although the solicitor says it could be the week after. If it does happen on the 19th, she'd like me to take the kids that morning so she can deal with the removal men. I'll pick them up at 8 and drop them back after tea. Remind me to check with her on the 17th whether it's still going ahead.
Tomás's band is playing at the Lexington on Friday at 9pm. He said the new drummer is still finding his feet.
Alessia's flat viewing on Tuesday at 6 was cancelled by the agent. She's trying to rebook for the weekend.
Kiara got into the choir! First rehearsal is on Wednesday evening.
Petra and her girlfriend have their fifth anniversary on Saturday. They're going to the coast for the weekend.
Need to call Hannah tomorrow afternoon about the sofa she's selling.
Emeka is nervous about his presentation to the board on Thursday at 10. Text him good luck that morning and ask how it went afterwards.
Rana mentioned she'd like to visit sometime in the spring, possibly with her cousin.
Sunil's parents are moving from Leicester to be near him in Glasgow. They're selling up after Easter.
Sort out the council tax for the new address. Also set up the post redirect before the 1st.
Barbara Walsh, my old landlady, still sends a card every Christmas. She lives in Galway now and keeps hens.

Antoine and Svetlana came round for dinner. Antoine has a second interview in Lyon on the 6th at 2pm, and if he gets it they'll move over in the new year. Svetlana is less keen and is worried about finding work there. Remind me to message Antoine the day after the interview, and ask Svetlana over for coffee soon.
Zeynep's grandad has his ninetieth on Sunday. She's making him a photo book and has been scanning old pictures all week.
Mehmet said the appointment for his knee has been moved to Monday at 4.15. He's on crutches until then.
Yaw and Ravi are both coming to the barbecue next Saturday. Ravi's bringing his new puppy, Biscuit.

Bumped into Julia Moreau at the station. Her husband was made redundant last month and they're thinking about downsizing, maybe sometime next year. She's putting a brave face on it, but she looked exhausted. I should invite her for lunch soon and not mention the house.
Kenji is calling me on Sunday at 7pm his time, which is 11am here. Must actually be awake for it.
